rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual reply when you mean “yes” or agree.

example.english: Are you free to have dinner tomorrow? Yeah, I am.
example.traditional: 你聽日得閒食飯？係呀，我得閒。
example.jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 dak1 haan4 sik6 faan6 hai6 aa3 ngo5 dak1 haan4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese exclamation for celebrating good news or success.

example.traditional: 我終於搵到份工喇，好嘢！
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1 laa3 hou2 je5

rows.note: Pick this for a short, emphatic “Yeah!” of joy, especially in youthful or written-style exclamations.
Use this to acknowledge what someone has said without necessarily agreeing with it.

example.english: You said it will rain tomorrow? Yeah, I heard you.
example.traditional: 你話聽日會落雨？嗯，我聽到喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 ng6 ngo5 teng1 dou2 laa3
